responsibility: This file implements the concrete `Backend` for GCC Rust, translating the frontend's abstract backend requests into GCC tree and GIMPLE-ready structures. It owns creation of Rust scalar, aggregate, pointer, function, variable, label, expression, and statement trees; function and global declaration finalization; sectioned export-data writing; and special handling such as zero-sized variables through `Bvariable`, making it the main lowering bridge from Rust frontend semantics into GCC middle-end IR construction.
same_name_distinction: Defines the full GCC-backed `Backend` implementation and the operational logic of `Bvariable::get_tree`, including GCC tree/GIMPLE construction, function/global finalization, and export-data writing. In contrast to `rust-gcc.h`, which only exposes the small `Bvariable` wrapper type, this `.cc` file contains the main lowering implementation from Rust frontend abstractions into GCC IR.
